downloads.table_query_example: SELECT id, source_name, source_id, tile_id, sbid, n_gaus, ra, dec, total_flux_source, e_total_flux_source, peak_flux, e_peak_flux, maj_axis, min_axis, dc_maj, dc_min, s_code, separation_tile_centre, noise, gal_lon, gal_lat, flag_close FROM AS110.racs_dr1_sources_galacticcut_v2021_08_v01 WHERE dec >= -90.0 AND dec < -75.0

claim_class.label: CONDITIONAL

p_of_C1.label: CONDITIONAL
p_of_C1.scope: p conditional on the R106 EMPIRICAL_DIFF_SELECTION null families (RED / MID / FLAT) and on C1
p_of_C1.statement: every p here (p_mc, p_mc_display, gaussian_p, p_conditional) is conditional on the empirical DIFF family shape and on the C1 value fed in; the R106 C1 = 0 CRN mocks do not reproduce the observed overdispersion (overdispersion-reproducing mocks are open); not a calibrated significance; no physical attribution (R106 NVSS_REVIEW_CORRECTIONS.json claim_classes.conditional_prediction / physical_attribution)
p_of_C1.empirical_points: RACS points use RACS's own resolved/migrating class definition (25 arcsec beam, 887.5 MHz, edges scaled by an assumed alpha = 0.75) and include RACS tile/PSF systematics: they set a scale only and are not an independent estimate of the NVSS g_diff C1; the NVSS point is circular
p_of_C1.not_claimed: no calibrated p, no physical attribution, no family identification

claim_class.racs_contrast_p: CONDITIONAL: Poisson-sandwich and jackknife-Gaussian p are not calibrated (R106: overdispersion; no RACS null mocks run)
claim_class.statement: every p in this file is CONDITIONAL: p_of_C1 p values are conditional on the R106 EMPIRICAL_DIFF_SELECTION family shape and on C1 (the C1 = 0 mocks do not reproduce overdispersion); the RACS/NVSS contrast p are Poisson-sandwich / jackknife-Gaussian and uncalibrated; none is a calibrated significance; no physical attribution, no family identification

linear.note: differential = C1 of [W_i - W_j] for two bracket members, i.e. the l=1 power of delta_resolved - delta_compact if each class follows one bracket member; 4 max C1 is the Minkowski bound (sqrt(C_i)+sqrt(C_j))^2 over the extended set; V4 is the numerical convergence of the integrator only; the unexplained V3 low-l offset to CAMB is carried separately in with_V3_low_l_systematic

with_V3_low_l_systematic.note: upper envelope values x factor_up, lower x factor_down; see V3_low_l_systematic for the method

hmcode2020.note: differential = C1 of [W_i - W_j] for two bracket members, i.e. the l=1 power of delta_resolved - delta_compact if each class follows one bracket member; 4 max C1 is the Minkowski bound (sqrt(C_i)+sqrt(C_j))^2 over the extended set; V4 is the numerical convergence of the integrator only; the unexplained V3 low-l offset to CAMB is carried separately in with_V3_low_l_systematic

with_V3_low_l_systematic.note: upper envelope values x factor_up, lower x factor_down; see V3_low_l_systematic for the method

shot_noise.note: R106's closed form Cov = Cov_{C1=0} + df^2 (3 C1/4pi) I_2 uses the clustering-only C1 of g_diff; Poisson noise is generated by the multinomial placement inside Cov_{C1=0}. The with-shot-noise numbers are C1 + 1/Nbar for the count fields (TN16 Eq. 3.4) and C1_diff + 1/Nbar_off + 1/Nbar_diag for g_diff; feeding them into p(C1) double counts Poisson noise.

V3_low_l_systematic.method: power-law fit of |C_l^integrator/C_l^CAMB - 1| over the tested l per V3 window, extrapolated to l = 1; s = max over windows; integrator below CAMB at all tested l => one-sided upward factor 1/(1 - s) (the CAMB-like value if the deficit is a fractional deficit of the integrator)
V3_low_l_systematic.transfer_caveat: taken from the worst smooth Gaussian test window (b = 2); the radio n(z) brackets were not run through CAMB (runtime), so the factor is transferred, not measured, for them
V3_low_l_systematic.status: unexplained low-l offset to CAMB counts_density: not the integrator P(k) sampling or matter variable, CAMB accuracy variation recorded (V3_DIAGNOSTIC.json); carried as a systematic, not a correction
V3_low_l_systematic.gap_status: unexplained (not integrator P(k) sampling / matter variable, not CAMB accuracy)

camb_accuracy_variation.description: CAMB 2.0.5 counts_density, SplinedSourceWindow, b = 2, massless neutrinos, AccuracyBoost = lAccuracyBoost = b, lSampleBoost = 50; window (1.0, 0.30) only (sets the V3 low-l systematic; the (0.5, 0.15) accuracy-2 run exceeded 10 min in R108)

V3_low_l_systematic.applied_to: THEORY_C1 envelope.<pv>.with_V3_low_l_systematic, C1_forms_for_R106 *_x_V3_factor_up / *_and_V3_factor_up, P_OF_C1_THEORY points labelled 'x V3 low-l systematic', p_of_C1_margins *_x_V3

p_of_C1_margins_note: crossing_0p05 = C1 at which the conditional p of the EMPIRICAL_DIFF family reaches 0.05 (R106); margins are crossing / theory C1 (linear P(k)), without and with the V3 low-l systematic factor (x_V3: theory C1 x factor_up, so the margin is divided by factor_up)
